title: H-PDLP: GPU-Accelerated Linear Programming via Generalized PDHG and Homogeneous Self-Dual Embedding
summary: GPU-based first-order methods are emerging as an approach for solving large-scale linear programming (LP) problems. We present H-PDLP, a GPU first-order LP solver based on a generalized primal-dual hybrid gradient (PDHG) method for a homogeneous self-dual embedding of the LP, and study its numerical performance. The solver applies the restarted reflected Halpern iteration to the generalized PDHG operator, with the embedding encoding both primal-dual optimal solutions and certificates of primal or dual infeasibility.
